text: {"distance_m": 5, "reasoning_short": "Contrast is about 5% (sensitivity of about 20). Under normal indoor light, threshold data for small discs (roughly threshold contrast × area = constant, with about 50% contrast needed at 1 arcmin) puts the smallest detectable spot at about 2.5–3 arcmin. A 4 mm spot shrinks to that size at roughly 4.5–5.5 m, so about 5 m. A sine-grating contrast-sensitivity estimate gives a higher bound of about 9 m, so this is an approximation."}
